grammar.title: Already, long since with 早已
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 早已 + 动词短语 + 了
grammar.explanation: 早已 (zǎoyǐ) means "already, long since" — a stronger, more formal version of 已经, showing that something happened a long time before now. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.en: This problem was already solved long ago.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zǎoyǐ bù shì xuésheng le.
sentences.en: She hasn't been a student for a long time.
